atAGlance: Phở chín is beef phở with cooked beef slices, rice noodles, herbs, and clear fragrant broth. It is the safer choice if you want phở without rare meat.
whatItIs: Phở chín is beef phở with cooked beef slices, clear broth, rice noodles, onion, herbs, and lime. It keeps the classic phở flavor while avoiding rare meat.
howToEnjoy: Taste the broth first, then add herbs, lime, bean sprouts, or chili little by little. The cooked beef is already ready to eat.
howLocalsOrder: Phở chín is the safer phở order when you want well-done beef from the start. Taste the broth first, then add herbs or lime; ask for no chili before chili oil or sliced chilies go in.
worthKnowing: Chín means cooked or well-done. Learning chín helps you order phở in Vietnam without accidentally getting rare beef.
goodToKnow: Chín means cooked or well-done here. You still season the bowl at the table with herbs, lime, bean sprouts, or chili.

orderLine.vietnamese: Cho tôi một tô phở chín.
orderLine.english: I’d like one bowl of pho with well-done beef.
orderLine.pronunciation: chaw toy moht toh fuh chin
